page.content:
Maradona's punched quarter-final goal against England in 1986.

How Hand of God connects

  • Character: Diego Maradona — Maradona punched in the Hand of God against England.
  • Event: 1986 FIFA World Cup — The Hand of God happened in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final.
  • Location: Estadio Azteca — The Hand of God was scored at Estadio Azteca.

What is Hand of God?

The Hand of God is Maradona's 1986 quarter-final opener against England — a fist he later named, four minutes before the Goal of the Century in the same match.

Key threads lead to Diego Maradona, 1986 FIFA World Cup and Estadio Azteca.
